headline: CMS INDUSLAW advises Rising Tide on follow-on investment in Battery Smart
sum: Rising Tide has made follow-on investments in the Series C1 & C2 funding rounds of Upgrid Solutions Private Limited, dba Battery Smart. CMS INDUSLAW advised Rising Tide on these investments.
detail: Rising Tide has made follow-on investments in the Series C1 & C2 funding rounds of Upgrid Solutions Private Limited, dba Battery Smart. CMS INDUSLAW advised Rising Tide on these investments. The transaction team consisted of Shweta Gupta (Partner) and Abhinav A (Associate). Kartik Ganapathy (Founding Partner) provided strategic inputs on the transaction.
